gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-buhid: Bent-wire sign lettering, bold and expressive, all in one thickness: that is Grandstander. And Noto Sans Buhid, a sans with generous gaps where curves meet stems, probably wants a little extra size to show them.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-carian: Grandstander is bold, expressive lettering that looks laser-cut from sheet. Noto Sans Carian is the sans-serif beneath, its terminals held apart like open scissor blades, so a slightly larger size would let them show.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-coptic: Chunky, glare-proof lettering: Grandstander keeps every stroke thick enough that nothing thin can wash out. And Noto Sans Coptic, in a block of text, lets the middle zone dominate, with open, uncrowded mouths on s and c.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-deseret: Flat, unmodulated stroke weight gives Grandstander its bold, expressive look, with letters held open. But where Grandstander grabs attention, Noto Sans Deseret earns its place through open apertures that keep the sans-serif legible.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-elbasan: Grandstander looks like glass-tube lettering, bold and expressive, with a hollow, constant thickness. Noto Sans Elbasan follows with large lowercase forms and open terminals, a quieter sans-serif counterweight to the glow.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-glagoli: Grandstander is bold and expressive, its rounded strokes like cut lengths of cord. Noto Sans Glagolitic does the opposite job, with open round letters that stay readable at small sizes, leaving the shouting to Grandstander.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-gothic: Solder pulled through a nozzle: that is Grandstander, bold and expressive, with strokes that never change width. Noto Sans Gothic glides along, its round counters like drilled glass beads.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-hebrew: Grandstander draws bold, expressive letters in flat, unmodulated line weight, none of them curled shut. Noto Sans Hebrew then settles into a long run with a dominant midsection and wide gaps between curve ends and stems.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-hk: Grandstander is bold and expressive, its diagonals matching the horizontals in weight. And Noto Sans HK, a sans-serif with large lowercase and brush ends lifted away before each curve closes, should carry paragraph after paragraph smoothly.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-kharosh: One stroke width runs from A to Z in Grandstander, bold and expressive. Noto Sans Kharoshthi supplies the dark stripe of lowercase, a sans whose curves never close back on themselves, giving headings solid ground.
